value.paper_weight_provenance: 2024 active weights retained; Eq7=.05, Eq16=.1, NPS=.01 are declared unverified author coefficients
value.paper_nps_sampling: Both checkerboard parities; four axial one-pixel neighbors; omit image-edge neighbors; Euclidean nearest-static-pixel-center distance; sum, not mean.
value.paper_opacity_domain: full raw-alpha MSE against binary Md; coefficient100 inherited control

value.retained_representation: Original native temporal-static branch plus missing real a5 source rows; all original600K records preserved.
value.smoke_accounting: separate from formal10k; same30k schedule; additional checkpoint/evaluation nodes

value.model_time_channel: nx (the original loader uses normals[:,0]); all original fields including time and RGB are copied verbatim
value.dynamic_exclusion: Original strict nearest XYZ distance<0.1m to selected a37 full prior; no actor-specific gate or bypass
value.loader_rule: readWaymoInfo_add reads existing points3d.ply, applies original selected-dynamic0.1m exclusion, and returns that static cloud. Its separate600K np.random.choice on rebuilt LiDAR is not used for static initialization when initialization=False.
value.KNN_scale_note: Unmodified native distCUDA2 re-evaluates nearest-neighbor scales with the added support; nearby old Gaussian scales may change naturally. No manual scale restoration or other parameter patch is applied.
value.initialization_color_note: Original full a5 PLY RGB fields are all0; they are copied exactly. The unmodified native loader initializes BasicPointCloud colors to0 for both arms. No RGB or point is synthesized from a rendering.
value.scientific_scope: Specific real a5 initialization-support intervention, including local count/density and capacity changes; not a same-point-count geometry superiority claim.

note: Original duplicate sampled rows are preserved; this is a real-support/capacity intervention, not a same-count comparison.
